summary: Frontend-only regression of 6 follow-up items on the Metin2 promo site (localStorage mock, no backend). All 6 items PASS: (1) featured card VIP badge text is exactly '👑 VIP' with red (DragonPvP) / green (PhoenixMT2) classes; (2) AddServer tab2 feature selects and tab3 sys-select-* + Efsun select are tri-state (Var / Yok / ➖ Belirtilmemiş (N/A)) and N/A selection works; (3) created server 'TriState' (#312) with Lycan+Kostüm N/A and Boss Takip N/A — those features are absent from both server detail chips and Home card, while 'Yok' items still render as ❌ (Simya, Çevrimdışı Pazar); (4) no taxonomy pick block (tax-pick) in Genel Özellikler; (5) admin banner impression counters increased after viewing Home (ust 2102→2104, sol 1504→1508) and click counters incremented after clicking top and side banners (88→89, 40→41); (6) admin VIP warning badge works: +4d '⚠ 5g kaldı' (red), past '⛔ Süre doldu' (red), +14d '15g kaldı' (green), +60d no badge, tier=none no badge.

integration_issues.issue: Impressions increment by 2 per page view (React StrictMode double-invokes the useEffect in TopBanners/AdSlot), so counters inflate at 2x. Also AdSlot mounts on every route (incl. /admin), so 'sol'/'sag' impressions count admin page views too. Functional but stats are inflated.

Seed banner id=4 (position 'sag') has active:false, so the right page-skin falls back to the static image with no data-testid and no tracking. After toggling admin-banner-toggle-4 on, side-banner-4 renders and tracks correctly. Confirm this default is intentional.
POP-UP banner (id=1) impressions do not increment when popup was already seen in the session (by design, noted for completeness).

issues: Uses native browser <input type="date"> picker instead of the shadcn calendar component
React dev console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' hydration warning caused by the visual-editor instrumentation wrapping option text (dev-only, non-blocking)

action_items: Optional: de-duplicate banner impression tracking (use a ref guard) so StrictMode/dev double-mount doesn't double-count; consider only counting side-banner impressions on public pages, not /admin.
Optional: decide whether seed banner id=4 ('sag') should be active by default so the right page-skin is tracked out of the box.
Optional: replace the native date input in Admin VIP cell with the shadcn calendar for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: AddServer tab2 feature selects had no data-testid; I added data-testid="feat-select-<key>" (and feat-select-efsunSabit) for parity with sys-select-<key>. Keep these for future automation.
Pre-existing lint error in AddServer.jsx:119 (unescaped apostrophe in the banner hint text) — react/no-unescaped-entities.
seed_data_creation: Created server 'TriState' (#312, Tri 1-99) in localStorage during the test run; toggled banner id=4 active. Both are per-run browser-local state, nothing persistent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 iteration-6 items verified via Playwright on the public preview URL. Popup ad blocks clicks on first load — press Escape before interacting. Feature selects in AddServer tab2 now expose data-testid=feat-select-<key>. System keys: kEnvanter, bossTakip, guvenliPc, loncaAjan, ticaretCami, yardimciSaman, cevrimdisiPazar, itemKilitleme.
rca_of_the_issue: Banner impression double-count RCA: TopBanners (HomeSections.jsx:59) and AdSlot (Footer.jsx:39) call trackBannerImpression inside an empty-dep useEffect; React 18 StrictMode double-invokes effects in dev, and AdSlot is mounted by Layout on every route, so each navigation adds 2 impressions per side banner.
